decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive cards like Force of Will and Collector Ouphe to control the early game, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest. It also includes powerful interaction with cards like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor to maintain board presence and disrupt opponents' strategies. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color strategy, with efficient mana acceleration from cards like Black Lotus and the Moxen. Overall, the deck excels at combining aggression with disruption to outpace and overpower opponents.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly and efficiently. Utilizing powerful cards like Force of Will, Dark Ritual, and Ponder to set up the combo, the deck aims to cast Doomsday to stack the deck in a way that allows Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. Other cards like Demonic Tutor, Gush, and Demonic Consultation help the deck search for its combo pieces quickly, while disruption in the form of Force of Will and Flusterstorm protect the combo from opposing strategies.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to have efficient control over the game through disruption and card advantage. Using cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Force of Negation to counter threats, along with removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck aims to dig through its library quickly with cards like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Brainstorm to find the right answers at the right time. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion of key cards for a more consistent control strategy.

This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and generating value through spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. It aims to control the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal spells like Fatal Push, and disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Lurrus of the Dream-Den for additional advantage. With a mix of traditional control elements and unique card choices, this Dimir Control deck looks to outmaneuver and outvalue its opponent.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using artifact ramp like Moxen, Mana Crypt, and Grim Monolith, as well as Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy. The key strategy involves using Paradoxical Outcome to bounce back high-cost artifacts like Coveted Jewel and The One Ring to generate card advantage and mana. The deck also utilizes cards like Force of Will for protection and Tinker to search for key pieces like Time Vault. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble a powerful board state and outvalue the opponent through efficient mana generation and card draw.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and mana acceleration to generate a lot of mana quickly and then either win through a combo involving Paradoxical Outcome and Coveted Jewel, or by using cards like Tinker to fetch powerful artifacts like Time Vault. The deck also includes disruption elements like Sink into Stupor and Force of Will to control the game and protect its combo pieces. The goal is to assemble the key pieces of the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and game-winning sequence of plays.

The deck focuses on using Coveted Jewel as a key piece in a combo strategy to generate massive amounts of mana and draw cards. With various artifacts and land cards such as Mishra's Workshop and Tolarian Academy, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and control the board with counterspells like Force of Will. By utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge, the deck can draw through the library rapidly to find the win condition - either Time Vault combo or overwhelming the opponent with powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board. It takes advantage of powerful card draw and tutoring effects to find key cards like Demonic Tutor and Ancestral Recall. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility and resilience to the control strategy.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Aggro-MUD deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Sphere of Resistance, Chalice of the Void, and Thorn of Amethyst, while also ramping up quickly with Mishra's Workshop and Mana Crypt. The deck utilizes artifacts like Stonecoil Serpent and Wurmcoil Engine as threats, and has land destruction elements with cards like Ghost Quarter and Wasteland. Crucible of Worlds and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim provide additional utility and card advantage, making it a powerful and synergistic aggressive deck.

This Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt opponents with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It leverages the graveyard recursion ability of Lurrus of the Dream-Den to gain long-term value and grind out wins. An efficient mana base along with powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk provide the deck with card advantage and tempo advantage. The inclusion of cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation ensure the deck can protect its game plan while disrupting opponents'.

The deck focuses on leveraging the Oath of Druids card to quickly put powerful creatures into play, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes various disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mental Misstep to control the game and protect its key pieces. The sideboard includes tools like Show and Tell and Boseiju, Who Endures to adapt to different matchups. The goal is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining control of the game through efficient spells and manipulation of the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's plays with counterspells and removal spells like Fatal Push. It also utilizes cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to draw into more answers while using Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion for consistent recursion. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient card advantage and disruption, eventually winning the game through incremental advantage and card advantage. It also has a strong mana denial strategy with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to keep the opponent off balance.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for powerful cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Prized Amalgam to come back from the graveyard. Using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Noxious Revival to manipulate the graveyard, this deck aims to create explosive plays and overwhelm opponents with a combination of creatures and spells. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection against disruption, while Creeping Chill provides additional reach and damage. The deck's key strategy revolves around utilizing the graveyard as a resource to win the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through powerful spells like Force of Will and disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Flusterstorm. The key strategy revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat out big creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or other threats like Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck also includes powerful draw and search spells like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor to ensure consistency and versatility in gameplay. The strategy aims to control the opponent's resources while establishing a dominant board presence through efficient creature plays.

The deck focuses on playing disruptive artifacts like Sphere of Resistance, Chalice of the Void, and Lodestone Golem to slow down the opponent, while also utilizing Mishra's Workshop to play big threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Stonecoil Serpent. It also has a strong synergy with Crucible of Worlds and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient artifact creatures and disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to establish their game plan.

The deck revolves around utilizing the powerful combo of Underworld Breach along with cards like Hullbreacher, Brain Freeze, and Demonic Tutor to generate infinite mana and storm count, resulting in a lethal Brain Freeze to mill the opponent's entire library. The deck also includes key components like Force of Will for protection, along with powerful draw and tutor cards to set up the combo efficiently. The mana base is optimized for stability and speed, with various artifact acceleration pieces like Moxen and Sol Ring to quickly ramp into the combo pieces.
